candidates.spoken: Amtrak 188 failed because overspeed on a curve.
Amtrak Train 188 derailed on a curve in Philadelphia.
Carriages were torn apart, and eight people were killed.
Nothing stopped the train from overspeeding.
The engineer had lost track of where he was.
He accelerated instead of slowing down.
Automatic speed control wasn't active on that curve.
The engineer wasn't on his phone.
Positive Train Control was activated on the Northeast Corridor.
The system was activated on the Northeast Corridor soon after.
It started with engineer loses situational awareness. It ended with derailment.

script.spoken: Amtrak 188 failed because overspeed on a curve. Carriages were torn apart, and eight people were killed. The train entered the curve at about twice the speed limit. The engineer had lost track of where he was. He accelerated instead of slowing down. Automatic speed control wasn't active on that curve. Nothing stopped the train from overspeeding. The system was activated on the Northeast Corridor soon after.
